name: Royal Hotel Sanremo
positioning: Historic seafront hotel in Sanremo, dating back to 1872, with a subtropical park and a seawater pool designed by Gio Ponti
best_for: Families wanting a heated seawater pool with a children's area in season
Travelers who want a spa and garden setting on the Italian Riviera
Golfers heading to the Circolo Golf degli Ulivi above Sanremo

facts.text: The hotel's history dates back to 1872.
The hotel has a subtropical park, with the sea in front of it.
The Lawrence Lounge pairs mixology and cuisine, with live musical entertainment.
The restaurants serve Ligurian and Mediterranean cuisine with flavours of land and sea.
The Royal Wellness spa has a Vitarium and a Turkish bath made of pearl mosaic.
The spa's wet zone has a large hydromassage pool and emotional showers.
Spa treatments use the Mei SPA line, made with natural ingredients from Italian officinal plants.
Guests can play tennis and mini-golf on site.
Children up to 6 stay free when sharing their parents' room.
In July and August a pizzeria runs at the Corallina Restaurant by the pool.
Sanremo is about 60 minutes from Nice International Airport and 45 minutes from Monte-Carlo.
Nearby landmarks include Sanremo's medieval old town, known as La Pigna.

highlights.text: The swimming pool was designed by Gio Ponti in 1948 and sits in the hotel's park facing the Mediterranean.
The Lawrence Lounge in the lobby is named after the hotel's founder, Lorenzo Bertolini.
The outdoor pool is heated, filled with seawater and has a children's area.
Sea excursions into the Pelagos Sanctuary marine protected area offer the chance to spot dolphins and whales.
The 18-hole Circolo Golf degli Ulivi, designed by Peter Gannon and inaugurated in 1932, sits on the hill above Sanremo among olive and mimosa trees.

considerations.text: The Royal Wellness spa is reserved for adults; guests aged 16 and over may use it when accompanied by an adult.
The heated outdoor pool is open from April to October.
The Circolo Golf degli Ulivi is off-site, on the hill above Sanremo.
